old_description: LAVA TEXTILES is a Belgian family-owned knitting company since 1925. We combine many years of technical experience with state-of-the-art machinery for knitted fabrics. We are driven towards innovation, excellent quality and service at competitive prices thanks to our production facilities in Belgium (1925), USA (2007), Romania (2011), Indonesia (2018) and our brand new site in Mexico (2021). Creating extraordinary designs that confer real added value to the fabric is part and parcel of the company’s DNA.
about:
Lava Textiles, a Belgian family-owned knitting company, traces its roots to 1925 in Belgium. The firm expanded to the United States in 2007, establishing its American headquarters in York, South Carolina. Still under family ownership, the company operates production facilities across five countries: Belgium (1925), the United States (2007), Romania (2011), Indonesia (2018), and Mexico (2021).

The company specializes in knitted fabrics, combining decades of technical experience with state-of-the-art machinery. Its global network of plants enables large-scale fabric production, though specific facility sizes, headcounts, and annual volumes are not publicly disclosed.

Lava Textiles serves customers across the textile and apparel supply chain, though the company does not publicly list specific industries or client names. Its fabrics are designed to add value through innovative design and consistent quality.

According to the company, its differentiation lies in a commitment to innovation, excellent quality, and service at competitive prices. The firm emphasizes that creating extraordinary designs that confer real added value to the fabric is central to its identity.
